//: PostgreSQL. This section is the only place the application learns where its database is —
there is no connection string anywhere else. Every key can also be set as an environment
variable in the usual shape, e.g. Database__Password. Full reference: docs/POSTGRESQL_SETUP.md.
Host       - machine running PostgreSQL. localhost is this machine.
Port       - 5432 unless the server says otherwise.
Name       - the database, lower-case, as created by docs/POSTGRESQL_SETUP.md.
Username   - the application role that owns that database. Not postgres.
Password   - EMPTY HERE ON PURPOSE: this file is committed. In development put it in
The API refuses to start without one.
SslMode    - Prefer for a server on this machine; Require for anything reached over a network.
MigrateOnStartup - null means 'yes in Development, no otherwise'. A server applies migrations
with deploy\Migrate-Database.ps1 as its own release step.
ConnectionString - optional. A complete Npgsql connection string that, when set, replaces
every key above. For a managed host that hands you one ready-made.
